title: The singing glass trick is real stick-slip physics
caption:
That movie glass-rim trick? It actually works.
A cartoon diner rubs his fingertip around a glass rim, and it lets out a loud hum that stuns the whole restaurant.
Stick-slip friction: your finger grips and slips in tiny cycles, each tug making the glass vibrate at its natural resonant frequency, which is the note you hear.
Ever made a water glass sing at the dinner table?
Save this for your next dinner-table party trick.
